# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes target the latest `2.x` release only — please upgrade before
reporting an issue to confirm it's still present.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 2.x (latest release on PyPI) | ✅ |
| 1.x and older | ❌ |

If a future major version needs older lines to receive backported fixes,
this table will be updated to say which ones.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/nikhilvdev/logquill-python/security/advisories/new)
(the "Security" tab of this repository → "Report a vulnerability"). This
opens a private advisory visible only to maintainers until a fix is ready.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce, or a minimal proof-of-concept
- The affected version(s)

We'll acknowledge new reports as soon as possible, typically within a few
business days, and keep you updated as we investigate and prepare a fix.
Once a fix is released, we'll credit the reporter (unless you'd prefer to
stay anonymous) in the release notes and publish a GitHub Security Advisory.
